sections.title: charaNam
lyrics: sarinennuduru shaakthEyulu shakthi roopu neevanuchu - dharishanamulu mimu naanaa vidhulanu, thalapula koladula bhajinthuru
sirula mimune alpa buddhi, thalachina vaariki alpambaguduru - garimala mimunE ghanamani thalachina, ghana bhuddhulaku ghanudavu
nee valana korathE lEdu mari neeru koladi thaamaramu - Aavala bhaageeradhi thari baavula Aa jalame oorinayatlu
shrI vEnkatapathi neevaithE mamu chEkoni yunna daivamani - ee valenE nee sharananedanu idiyE para tathvamu naaku
